# SERPgpt.pro Full LLM Index & Application Architecture Specification

## Overview
SERPgpt.pro is a free web-based SEO & Keyword Intelligence platform designed to replace expensive paid suites (Semrush, Ahrefs, Moz, Screaming Frog, AnswerThePublic).

## Full URL Directory & Schema Specifications

### 1. Interactive Applications
- **Homepage** (`https://serpgpt.pro/`): Free Keyword Research Tool, Competitor Finder, and Multi-Platform Suite.
- **Google Keyword Planner Engine** (`https://serpgpt.pro/free-keyword-search`): Real-time Google autocomplete expansion, CPC bids, low-competition keywords, and Anti-Thin Page Architecture generator.
- **People Also Ask & Question Tree** (`https://serpgpt.pro/tools/people-also-ask`): AnswerThePublic alternative with interactive SVG radial question wheels and instant FAQPage JSON-LD schema exporter.
- **Local SEO Keyword Generator** (`https://serpgpt.pro/tools/local-seo-keywords`): Hyper-targeted "near me" service keywords, emergency 24/7 modifiers, and city landing page matrices with geo country selector (US, UK, CA, AU, NG, IN, DE, FR, BR, AE, JP, MX).
- **YouTube Keyword Tool** (`https://serpgpt.pro/youtube-keyword-tool`): YouTube autocomplete streams, video outlier ratio analysis, and tag generator.
- **Amazon A9 Keyword Tool** (`https://serpgpt.pro/tools/amazon-keyword-tool`): Live A9 buyer search autocomplete and 249-byte backend search term generator.
- **TikTok Trend Finder** (`https://serpgpt.pro/tools/tiktok-keyword-tool`): FYP viral trend search suggestions and hashtag blocks.
- **Etsy 13-Tag Generator** (`https://serpgpt.pro/tools/etsy-keyword-tool`): Etsy shopper search completion and 20-character listing tag validator.
- **Sitemap Link Extractor** (`https://serpgpt.pro/sources/site-map-extractor`): Scrape URLs, directory structures, and media links from XML sitemaps with CSV export.
- **Competitor Intelligence Suite** (`https://serpgpt.pro/alternatives/free-competitor`): Domain competitor finder, similarity scores, backlink counts, and keyword gap analysis.

## Indexing & Crawling Policy
- All pages allow indexing (`index, follow`).
- Full access granted to AI agents (`GPTBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `PerplexityBot`, `Google-Extended`, `ClaudeBot`, `Applebot-Extended`).
